maria.chen: Noticing inconsistent error shapes across SDKs. Can we standardize a minimal error payload and typed exceptions?
kevin: Yes. We should have semantic `error_code`, `http_status`, `retryable`, `retry_after_seconds`, `user_message`, `developer_message`, and `meta.request_id`.
nash_winchester: Also expose `idempotent` on endpoint docs so SDKs know when auto-retry is safe.
danielle: For onboarding samples, show `user_message` to end users and log `developer_message`. Don't leak traces in `user_message`.
kevin: SDK surface: base `RedwoodError` with fields `code`, `httpStatus`, `retryable`, `retryAfterSeconds`, `meta`, `userMessage`, `developerMessage`. Typed subclasses: `UnauthorizedError`, `RateLimitedError`, `ServerError`.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI: branch `sdk-error-unify` pushed -> https://ci.internal/1122 :robot_face:
maria.chen: Action items: I'll draft RFC + migration notes. Ash to add server mapping middleware. Danielle to update sample apps. Kevin to add SDK tests.
kevin: Keep backwards compat: until next major, keep `error.message` equal to `user_message`. We'll document the change in changelog.
maria.chen: Thanks, everyone. I'll ping for RFC review tomorrow.
